title: Bulk-silicon QE symmetry-path band tutorial
status_detail: Exactly one authorized local single-process QE 7.2 tutorial bands invocation completed with exit status 0, End of band structure calculation, and JOB DONE. Compact provenance, complete artifact inventory, accepted-source nonmutation evidence, warnings, and an observational legacy comparison are retained. The Task remains active awaiting human review; automatic successor activation is disabled and no downstream Task is active.
objective: Reproduce one authoritative or bundled Quantum ESPRESSO silicon band-structure example using an explicitly identified converged SCF state, retain compact provenance, inspect the resulting artifacts, and determine the minimum band-record requirements without claiming production convergence or effective-mass validity.
authorized_scope: Select and retain the exact QE 7.2 PW example01 silicon Davidson bands input generated by the bundled run_example source.
Before execution, verify the accepted silicon.save identity and prepare an isolated copy so the accepted external SCF artifacts are not overwritten or deleted.
After separate activation and execution authorization, run exactly one local single-process pw.x calculation='bands' against the isolated SCF-state copy; do not invoke the bundled cleanup script.
Retain a sanitized input, compact execution provenance, separate streams and exit state, an artifact inventory, source and comparison identities, and the unresolved-warning disposition.
Inspect stdout, QEXSD, and native save-directory changes and determine only the minimum additional band-record requirements supported by the observed result.
Present the bounded tutorial observations and proposed record boundary for concise human review.
completion_criteria: The exact source, input, executable, pseudopotential, parent SCF artifact identity, isolated scratch path, resources, and one-execution authorization are recorded before execution.
The accepted SCF artifact tree remains unchanged and the tutorial bands execution, if authorized, has an explicit immutable execution result or failure record.
Every observed or expected band-oriented artifact has an explicit identity, role, completeness, and retention disposition.
The 28-point tpiba path, eight retained bands, energy-reference availability, and parent-child lineage are explicit.
Any proposed minimal band-record extension is based only on observed artifacts and is reviewed without implementing a parser or public record in this Task.
The review distinguishes tutorial software behavior from production convergence, effective-mass validity, Wannier suitability, tight-binding dataset adequacy, and scientific validation.
exclusions: Planning does not activate this Task, create a calculation checkpoint, or authorize QE execution.
The bundled run_example is not executed because it reruns SCF and deletes silicon scratch artifacts.
No accepted external SCF artifact is modified; execution must use an identity-verified isolated copy.
No production cutoff, mesh, path, band count, pseudopotential, convergence tolerance, or physical-validation criterion is selected.
No local-valley fit, effective-mass extraction, Wannierization, tight-binding fit, parser, record implementation, dependency change, or source-code change is included.
The legacy band path is not treated as a Brillouin-zone integration mesh, a Wannier mesh, a robust effective-mass dataset, or a complete tight-binding training and validation dataset.
Agreement with the bundled legacy reference is tutorial comparison evidence only, not numerical verification or scientific validation.
